newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel submits transport plan - minister.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel submits transport plan - minister.

text.p: Troubled Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc has submitted to the authorities a plan for a limited return to passenger service, the French junior transport minister said on Tuesday.

"Eurotunnel submitted yesterday to the appropriate authorities, the bi-national safety committee, a plan for a partial return to service which concerns the Eurostar and Le Shuttle," Anne-Marie Idrac said in parliamentary questions.
The investigating magistrate has completed an examination of the Channel Tunnel site, Eurotunnel said. A fire last week badly damaged part of the Tunnel and disrupted passenger services.
Various teams from the Franco-British inter-governmental safety commission, insurers and construction companies have started their initial investigations of the Tunnel.
The company is allowing news agency photographers and television and radio reporters to enter the tunnel now that conditions are considered safe.
